He walked to the high council of Sentenza and applied to an appeal, which he brought forward to those gathered there:

I am Mar'dy Kist. I was the one who wrote the letter originally to the great civilizations on behalf of the Flora. As far as I know, you were the only ones to respond and give the Flora refuge. With the help of others, we brought them here and saved them from their cruel fates. I am eternally grateful to this city for your courage and bravery.

I defended this city as I could, the Flora defended this city as they could. So I bring forward a few appeals, some of which may seem obvious to pass, some of which may seem unattainable:

1. To grant the Flora citizenship. Their curse has been removed, rather than send out the few thousand here, I would ask that they be incorporated into the civilization. They can be productive members of your society like the many different species that already are.

2. To grant citizenship to myself. I am a free individual, and I seek citizenship as a member of this faction. My freedom cannot be contested by other kingdoms or Orders if this is to pass.

For the following ideas, I agree to campaign, organize and fund-raise the construction of all these things, I only ask for the land required:

3. To build the Patterned Gardens within the walls of Sentenza. A tribute to the Flora, the patterned gardens will preserve the knowledge they once had in the form of gardens. It will also have groves of paper trees for the next two things. It will also be a great tourist attraction.

4. To build the Crystal Library. A huge library built in Sentenza, the first of its kind, it will strive to gather and keep knowledge from the entirety of Gaea. It will be constructed out of crystals from the forests that now surround this city. The pros of this building are obvious.

5. To establish the first University. Connected with the library, the university will rocket Sentenza to the forefront of technology world-wide. It will allow for the education of its people, allowing more people to be involved in research and development of new technologies and work with each other. This university will also be multifaceted, with both a Technology Wing for the technology research, a Magics Wing for the exploration of magical arts, a Martial Wing for the exploration of fighting techniques and defense, it will train any warriors that wish to learn. The Wings will collaborate to bring all this knowledge together and cross-apply it.
